_description: TY2025 IRS graduated tax brackets — Qualifying Surviving Spouse. Available to NRA filers per Form 1040-NR instructions when the filer's spouse died in the previous 2 tax years and the filer maintains a household for a qualifying child. Source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-40 (October 2024).
